name: whatsrook
postCreateCommand: set -e && mkdir -p /tmp/ffmpeg && curl -fL https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz -o /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz && tar xJ --strip-components=1 -C /tmp/ffmpeg -f /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz && sudo mv /tmp/ffmpeg/ffmpeg /tmp/ffmpeg/ffprobe /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf /tmp/ffmpeg /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz && sudo curl -fL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && sudo mv "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
